title: Security Is a Philosophy, Not a Feature
excerpt: Most companies treat security like a checkbox. That's exactly why they keep getting breached.
content:
There is a pattern to every major data breach.

The Checklist Illusion

Threats evolve. Checklists don't.

Trust Is the Real Architecture

Every security decision is a trust decision.

title: The World Is Loud With Bad Advice
excerpt: The world is loud with bad advice. Everyone wants to be a prophet with nothing holy in their mouths.
content:
The world is loud with bad advice.
Everyone wants to be a prophet
with nothing holy in their mouths.

They say trust the process,
but the process is eating people alive.

title: “Heaven Knows Why”
excerpt: They said, “Heaven knows why.”  And I almost laughed not because it was funny.
